Over the long illustrious history of StarCraft, both past and present, the public face of the e-Sport has been its tournaments and leagues. These competitions brought together the preeminent players of the period to provide presentation platforms for many of the finest performances recorded. These Tournament Portal pages serve to provide a catalog of all the tournaments and leagues that have a presence on Liquipedia and a glimpse of their vital statistics.

If a noteworthy tournament is absent or insufficiently documented, please consider authoring or contributing to making the site more comprehensive.
